Full job description

About Quartex

Quartex is a global software provider helping large and growing companies in asset-intensive industries Run Every Site Right™.

Our software delivers the indispensable tools organisations need to move and house their workforce, protect people and places from harm, and reduce operational risk, all while safeguarding their licence to operate.

From flight scheduling and accommodation to permitting, disclosures and resource governance, Quartex helps customers manage complex operations with confidence. With more than two decades of experience and a customer base spanning Australia, North America, Africa, South America and beyond, we are trusted by industry leaders to support remote, complex and high-risk operations.

Joining Quartex means becoming part of a growing team with a clear purpose and global impact. You’ll work in a collaborative, forward-thinking environment where ideas are valued, growth is supported and your contribution matters.

Here’s what you can look forward to:

Wellbeing first — access confidential mental health support and a comprehensive Wellbeing Centre with resources for fitness, nutrition, mindfulness and financial health.
Work your way — enjoy flexible hours, hybrid working, floating holidays and location flexibility.
Family support — benefit from parental leave and flexibility that helps you balance career growth with family life.
Perks that matter — access corporate benefits, novated leasing and exclusive savings with popular brands.
A values-led culture — be part of a team where contributions are recognised and career growth is championed.

About the role

We are seeking an Associate Software Engineer to join our team. You’ll help build reliable, intuitive software that delivers value to our customers, using AI tools throughout Quartex’s AI Product Development Life Cycle (AIPDLC). You’ll thrive if you enjoy solving problems, collaborating with others, and learning new technologies.

As our newest Associate Software Engineer, you’ll:

Develop and maintain quality software that meets customer requirements, acceptance criteria, and team standards.
Use approved AI tools to support development, testing, and documentation, taking ownership of the accuracy, security, and quality of all output.
Create unit tests, resolve bugs, and contribute to reliable builds, deployments, and production support.
Collaborate with Engineering and Product teams to deliver work on time, identify risks, and improve development practices.

What You’ll Bring

We’re looking for someone who is curious, collaborative, and keen to learn. You communicate clearly, take responsibility for your work, and welcome feedback while contributing to shared team goals.

You’ll also bring:

A degree in Computer Science or a related discipline, with some software development experience.
Exposure to programming languages, frameworks, and tools such as .NET, Node.js, JavaScript, React, Git, and SQL.
An understanding of agile development, cloud platforms, web services, unit testing, and continuous integration and deployment.
Hands-on exposure to AI development tools such as Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or Cursor, with an understanding of their limitations and the need to validate their output.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Quartex, we know even minor issues can lead to major problems in the industries we serve. That’s why we’re driven to help our customers get better insights, take smarter actions, and see stronger results. We support flexible working arrangements, with three days a week in the office to support face-to-face collaboration and team connection.

You’ll join a team that:

Focuses on our customer, tailoring solutions for real impact.
Builds to be useful & useable, with practical, reliable software.
Collaborates to innovate, working alongside customers to refine and enhance our products.
Stays grounded, with a deep understanding of the sectors we serve.

Next Steps

Ready to help our clients Run Every Site Right™ and grow your career while doing it? Click Apply to send us your CV.

As a Circle Back Initiative employer, we commit to responding to every applicant, because your time and application matter.
